description: This file defines configuration options and a validator class for Azure Storage Gateway within the Orleans clustering framework. It includes a class for setting the table name and a validator class for validating these options.

classes.name: AzureStorageGatewayOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Azure Storage Gateway, extending AzureStorageOperationOptions, with a default table name.

classes.name: AzureStorageGatewayOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class for AzureStorageGatewayOptions, inheriting from AzureStorageOperationOptionsValidator.

methods.name: AzureStorageGatewayOptionsValidator
methods.description: Constructor for the validator class, initializing with options and name, and passing them to the base class.
